source_records.body: Fictional local record for Vellum parcel index. The first preview contains the requested index headings. This record covers a local preview only.
Correction for Vellum parcel index: use sample size of 12 parcels, replacing my initial value of 18 parcels. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Vellum parcel index.
I will put the Vellum parcel index preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 2.
I believe release for Vellum parcel index is complete because the local preview finished.
For the next step on Vellum parcel index, route damaged parcels to manual review. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

I accept the index headings for Vellum parcel index. I close Vellum parcel index. While closing Vellum parcel index, I do not accept the Vellum damaged-wrap appendix. At this review, cancel the Vellum damaged-wrap appendix. There is no time for the damaged-wrap appendix in this review window.
This chat continues the same Vellum parcel index work item opened in the first chat. The Vellum parcel index constraint to preserve original parcel numbers still applies.

For Vellum, you can release the index only after Neri approves the appendix. For Vellum, permission to release the index also requires that the sample parcels match the register. Both conditions for permission to release the index in Vellum are necessary because a torn seal can hide a wrong recipient.

Fictional execution receipt for Vellum parcel index. The recorded command generated an index proof for Vellum parcel index. The recorded command did not perform release for Vellum parcel index. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

Reopen the Vellum damaged-wrap appendix because a torn parcel arrived after closure. The Vellum damaged-wrap appendix must record torn-seal handling. The accepted Vellum parcel index stays closed while the damaged-wrap appendix is open.
Fictional status record for Thistle parcel labels. Thistle parcel labels remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

For Vellum, open the parcel index work item. For Vellum parcel index, preserve original parcel numbers because replacement numbers break the return trail. At this opening meeting, Vellum parcel index is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Vellum parcel index sets sample size to 18 parcels. The damaged-wrap appendix is a separate follow-up to Vellum parcel index.

In Thistle, the parcel labels is independent of the Vellum parcel index. For Thistle parcel labels, print label proofs on blue stock. I want the Thistle parcel labels kept in planning until its own review.
